entries.source: Welcome to Tales of Maj'Eyal - #CRIMSON#Ashes of Urh'Rok
entries.target: 欢迎来到马基埃亚尔的传说 - #CRIMSON#乌鲁洛克之烬
新职业：#LIGHT_GREEN#腐化者（恶魔使者）
新的种族外观选项：#LIGHT_GREEN#恶魔之角
新的种族外观选项：#LIGHT_GREEN#红色皮肤
欢迎来到#CRIMSON#乌鲁洛克之烬

entries.source:
Thank you for purchasing #CRIMSON#Ashes of Urh'Rok#WHITE#, the first expansion pack of Tales of Maj'Eyal.

To begin your adventures as a fiery bringer of doom simply create a character with the class #LIGHT_GREEN#Doombringer#WHITE# (in the Defiler category) and a race of #LIGHT_BLUE#%s#WHITE#.

Have fun crushing your foes!
entries.target:
感谢你购买#CRIMSON#乌鲁洛克之烬#WHITE#，《马基埃亚尔的传说》的第一个扩展包。

要以带来毁灭的烈焰使者身份开始冒险，只需创建一个角色：职业选择#LIGHT_GREEN#毁灭使者#WHITE#（堕落系），种族选择#LIGHT_BLUE#%s#WHITE#。

尽情碾碎你的敌人吧！

entries.source: You were not supposed to see that!
Found the Forbidden Tome reward inside the Forbidden Tome: "Of Knowledge And Horrors".
entries.target: 在禁忌之书《知识与恐怖》中，找到禁忌之书的奖励。

entries.source: Left the Forbidden Tome: "Home, Horrific Home" on the floor of The Home Which Is Not.
entries.target: 将禁忌之书《家，可怕的家》留在了“非家之家”的地板上。

entries.source: Discovered the true origin of dwarves and drems.
entries.target: 发现矮人和德瑞姆的来历。

entries.source: Win without having saved Kroshkkur, Derth, the lost merchant, Melinda and lady Aeryn.
entries.target: 在不拯救克诺什库尔、德斯镇、迷路的商人、梅琳达和艾琳的情况下获得胜利。
使用5种不同的符文序列。

entries.source: Is that how it feels to be an escort quest?!
entries.target: 这就是被护送的感受么？！

entries.source: Got saved from death in the Godfeaster by Malyu and managed to escape.
entries.target: 在噬神者中被马虑从死亡边缘救下，并成功逃脱。

entries.source: Let a parasitic horror take over your body and watch it grow in power.
entries.target: 让寄生恐魔占据身体，日渐强大。

entries.source: Learned all there is to learn about the Gods and the Godslayers.
entries.target: 了解目前关于神和噬神者的所有信息。

entries.source: Vanquished the Glass Golem without letting it use the glass throne to heal.
entries.target: 在不让玻璃傀儡借助玻璃王座治疗的情况下击败它。

entries.source: Briefly lived as a lowly halfling during the time of the Sher'tuls.
entries.target: 短暂地作为一名半身人活在夏·图尔的时代。

entries.source: The thirst for knowledge is seen by most arcane users as as good thing.
entries.target: 对知识的渴望被大多数奥术使用者视为一件好事。

entries.source: But some take it too far, some delve into lost knowledge. They may gain huge power from it, but at what cost?
entries.target: 但某些人走得太远，某些人陷入失落的知识中。他们或许得到了巨大的力量，但代价是什么呢？

entries.source: Writhing Ones know that what we call #{italic}#horrors#{normal}# hold the key to some ancient knowledge and power from the Age of Haze and they are ready to do anything to access it.
entries.target: 蠕动者知道，我们所谓的#{italic}#恐魔#{normal}#掌握着混沌纪远古知识与力量的关键，他们愿意为获取这些而不择手段。

entries.source: In their lust for power they somehow lost a part of themselves, turning more and more into the horrors they study.
entries.target: 在极度渴求力量的同时，他们似乎失去了部分自我，和他们所研究的恐魔越来越相似。

entries.source: Most of them forgo an entire arm to turn it into a deadly tentacle.
entries.target: 他们中大部分人选择将一整只手臂化作致命触手。

entries.source: Some are even known to never leave their sanctuary without their own worm that walks friend.
entries.target: 某些人甚至拒绝在没有蠕虫合体的陪同下离开避难所。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Magic
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和魔力。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 力量，+0 敏捷，+3 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 魔力，+0 意志，+0 灵巧

entries.source: Everything ends eventually. Harness this inevitability.
entries.target: 万物终将消亡。这一点可以被利用。

entries.source: Cultists of Entropy are doomed beings which have unlocked the secrets of using entropy as a weapon. Their spells cause their bodies to wither away from entropic backlash, but they have learned how to resist this backlash and even pass it onto their foes.
entries.target: 熵教徒是被诅咒的存在，他们能使用熵作为武器。他们的法术产生熵能反冲伤害自身，但他们学会如何抵抗反冲甚至将其转移至敌人身上。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic and Cunning
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力和灵巧。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+0 敏捷，+0 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +6 魔力，+0 意志，+3 灵巧

entries.source: Drem are mindless mutants who live deep in the earth. It is only recently that thinking Drem have appeared among them. They still remain deep below Eyal's surface, believing that they would not be welcomed among the surface races.
entries.target: 德瑞姆是生存于地底深处、没有心智的异变种，直到最近才在其中出现具有思维能力的个体。他们仍生存于地底，认为他们不会被地上种族欢迎。

entries.source: They possess the #GOLD#Frenzy#WHITE# talent which allows them to ignore cooldowns once in a while.
entries.target: 他们拥有 #GOLD#狂热#WHITE# 技能，让他们偶尔能无视冷却时间。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 力量，+1 敏捷，+1 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +2 魔力，-1 意志，+0 灵巧
